alignments.note: Anarthrous predicate noun with its supplied indefinite determiner as a rule 51 helper.
Rule 22: a substantival article takes the supplied nominal with its own determiner, headed on the nominal word, and the case preposition of rides along under rule 21.
Participle rendered by the infinitive to come; the infinitival marker is a rule 7 helper on its verb, no conjunction governing the clause.
Subject noun σῶμα → body, standing bare.
Rule 20: the ASV writes Christ's with the possessive on the name itself, so this article realizes nothing.
Rule 63: the subject is a lexical noun, so the supplied copula is the predicate's helper and rides with the possessive predicate, headed on the word realizing the name.

review_notes: The copula is placed on the predicate under rule 63 rather than on σῶμα, the subject being a noun and not a pronoun; rule 53 has already refused to read a supplied copula off English word order.
Variant SBLGNT.COL.2.17.v015 is underdetermined on r00-base and covers s009, an article the ASV does not realize in any reading; rule 97 is not in play.
